subject: Invoice VEN007-0023 - input tax credit discrepancy
body:
Dear Unity Media LLP team,

We are reconciling our purchases with GSTR-2B and found a problem with invoice VEN007-0023 dated 20 Sep 2025.

The Supplier's GSTR-2B line carries Rs 14,769 of tax and the invoice Rs 17,127. Only the lower amount is safe to claim.

Rs 2,359 of input tax credit depends on this. Please look into it and confirm once it is corrected in your return.

Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
GSTIN 07AAACS1234F1ZU
